screen.z80z_shoulder_aim_sync.title: Shoulder Camera Settings
Toggles and sliders save instantly; lists commit when closing.
screen.z80z_shoulder_aim_sync.reset.tip: Restore every option to its default and save immediately.
screen.z80z_shoulder_aim_sync.hint.keys: %s cycle view · %s swap shoulder · %s toggle settings — rebind in Options > Controls
screen.z80z_shoulder_aim_sync.hint.addon: TACZ-addon detected: while its 'switch to first person when aiming' is on, shoulder aim zoom only applies briefly after aiming starts.
Master switch; off restores the vanilla camera entirely.
option.z80z_shoulder_aim_sync.takeover.t: Cycle order: first person → shoulder → third back → third front.
option.z80z_shoulder_aim_sync.autoShould: Switch to shoulder view when entering a world; requires F5 takeover.
option.z80z_shoulder_aim_sync.followMode: Smooth = eased follow; Spring = damped with weight and sway; Fixed = zero-latency lock.
option.z80z_shoulder_aim_sync.transition: Camera follow easing time; lower tracks tighter.
Spring mode only: higher stiffness returns faster.
option.z80z_shoulder_aim_sync.damping.ti: Spring mode only: lower damping allows more sway.
option.z80z_shoulder_aim_sync.offsetX.ti: Lateral offset from the shoulder; smaller moves closer to the body axis.
option.z80z_shoulder_aim_sync.offsetY.ti: Vertical offset relative to the eyes; may be negative.
option.z80z_shoulder_aim_sync.back.tip: How far the camera sits behind the player.
option.z80z_shoulder_aim_sync.slide.tip: Duration of the shoulder-swap slide animation.
option.z80z_shoulder_aim_sync.viewSwitch: Smooth transition for F5 view switches, 0 = instant.
ON = right shoulder, OFF = left; the swap key toggles anytime.
Pull the camera in when a wall blocks the view.
option.z80z_shoulder_aim_sync.fadePlayer: Body, armor and elytra fade to translucent as the camera closes in; hidden entirely at extreme range.
option.z80z_shoulder_aim_sync.autoRiding: Shoulder view while mounted, revert on dismount; horses must be saddled. Use the blocklist to exclude entities.
option.z80z_shoulder_aim_sync.ridingBloc: Entity IDs excluded from mount auto-shoulder, comma separated, e.g. minecraft:boat.
option.z80z_shoulder_aim_sync.autoElytra: Shoulder view while gliding; reverts on landing or stopping.
option.z80z_shoulder_aim_sync.elytraDela: Glide ticks before the auto switch triggers.
option.z80z_shoulder_aim_sync.elytraRoll: Roll the view with your bank while turning in a glide.
Roll angle strength in degrees, 0 = disabled.
option.z80z_shoulder_aim_sync.zoom.tip: Narrow the FOV progressively while aiming.
option.z80z_shoulder_aim_sync.zoomStreng: Higher means stronger magnification; maps to the zoomFactor config.
option.z80z_shoulder_aim_sync.aimTime.ti: Transition time of the aim zoom and body push.
option.z80z_shoulder_aim_sync.followTacz: Use TACZ's gun-pack aim timing instead of the Zoom/Push Time above.
option.z80z_shoulder_aim_sync.push.tip: Push the camera toward the shoulder while aiming.
option.z80z_shoulder_aim_sync.pushDist.t: How far the camera pushes forward while aiming.
option.z80z_shoulder_aim_sync.zoomFp.tip: Also zoom in first person; stacks with TACZ scope magnification, best kept off.
option.z80z_shoulder_aim_sync.aimDelay.t: Hold ticks before aim registers, preventing flicker from quick clicks.
Let TACZ handle zoom when a scope (power > 1) is attached; iron sights still use this mod's zoom.
Empty hands and ordinary items follow vanilla interaction targets. Bows and crossbows show an aim-direction reference, not predicted arrow drop, spread, multishot or firework impact. First-person crosshairs remain with vanilla and TACZ.
option.z80z_shoulder_aim_sync.debugCross: Show a center marker and projection values to debug crosshair alignment.
option.z80z_shoulder_aim_sync.forceFpSni: Force first person while scoping a sniper; back to shoulder on release.
Black lens-fade when snapping to first person.
Exact sniper gun IDs (modid:path), comma separated.
option.z80z_shoulder_aim_sync.sniperKeyw: Substrings that mark a gun as a sniper; TACZ pack type fields take priority.
option.z80z_shoulder_aim_sync.gunMods.ti: Item namespaces that take part in gun detection, comma separated.
